author: claude

cloud_writes.what: creates an EXTERNAL dataset QA_<run id>, a MAP history job, an S3 upload and DSM tiling

expected: Processing completes and the DSM is available as a map; no 'Processing failed'. General DSM: Z11_Zurich_47.4N_1m_UTM32632.tif (synthetic, zero rotation), chosen by the user.

fixtures.delivery: engine: act.py deliver copies it to device_path on each tablet when it is missing and checks its sha256 there; a different file at that path is never overwritten
fixtures.name: Z11_Zurich_47.4N_1m_UTM32632.tif

forbidden: the main half of the Actions split button (Process)
btn-close-modal or a tap outside the dialog

preconditions.text: fixture present; sha256 recorded; its geotransform rotation/shear terms read and recorded before upload
CT account logged in on every target
test-data site a0000001 exists in the CT org on staging
the fixture is on the tablet at its device_path with the fixture's sha256 (the engine copies it at the start of each attempt: act.py deliver)

requirement.text: Also import a general DSM file you have, just to check so we did not break it

routing.symbol: btn-maps in the desktop bar (CSS width 1280 on the tablets)
split button: Process / Import map (testid import-map)
detached input type=file: the Android system picker

steps.text: Close a leftover Import file dialog (Cancel; only when one is open)
steps.when_js: (() => { const d = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop(); return !!(d && d.innerText.includes('Import file') && [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].some(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Cancel')); })()

steps.text: Top bar: Maps
Open the Actions menu (arrow half of the split button; never the main half, which reads Process)
Choose Import map
Confirm the classic import dialog (SurveyOutcomes off)
Open the system file chooser (photo picker opens)
Photo picker: More
Photo picker: Browse… (opens the full-screen file browser)
File browser: open the places (Show roots)
File browser: the internal storage (titled with the tablet's device name)
File browser: Download
File browser: the case's own folder QA-TERR-004
File browser: tap Z11_Zurich_47.4N_1m_UTM32632.tif, the only file in QA-TERR-004; the app comes back

assert.expr: 'Z11_Zurich_47.4N_1m_UTM32632.tif' in v['file_card']['text'] and '\nDSM\n' in v['file_card']['text'] and v['file_card']['next_disabled'] is False

steps.read_js: (() => { const d = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop(); const nx = d && [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Next'); return {text: d ? d.innerText : '', next_disabled: nx ? nx.disabled : null}; })()
steps.text: Read the file card: name, type DSM, first Next enabled
First Next (reads the coordinate system; writes nothing). The runner refuses every text:Next, so it is handed back
Dataset name
Close the keyboard
Open the Site select
Filter the site list
Choose the authorized test site
Close the keyboard

assert.expr: v['form']['name'] == 'QA_' + run and '\nQA engine\n' in v['form']['text'] and 'EPSG:32632' in v['form']['text'] and v['form']['next_disabled'] is False

steps.read_js: (() => { const d = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop(); const i = document.querySelector('[data-testid=input-dataset-name]'); const nx = d && [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Next'); return {text: d ? d.innerText : '', name: i ? i.value : null, next_disabled: nx ? nx.disabled : null}; })()
steps.text: Read the filled form
Second Next: creates the dataset in the QA engine site, a MAP job, the upload and the tiling (cloud write)

steps.read_js: (async () => { const t = localStorage.getItem('accessToken') || ''; const l = await window.Capacitor.Plugins.CapacitorHttp.get({url: 'https://api.staging.company.example/api/v1/datasets/sites/a0000001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', headers: {Authorization: 'Bearer ' + t}}); const d = (l.data || []).find(x => x.name === 'QA_{run}'); if (!d) return {found: false}; const r = await window.Capacitor.Plugins.CapacitorHttp.get({url: 'https://api.staging.company.example/api/v1/datasets/' + d.id + '/map-outputs', headers: {Authorization: 'Bearer ' + t}}); return {found: true, id: d.id, datasetStatus: (r.data || {}).datasetStatus, outputs: ((r.data || {}).outputs || []).map(o => o.type + ':' + o.status)}; })()
steps.text: Wait for the server-side processing (app estimate 10-50 min; the 2026-10-23 runs took 4 to 10 min)
Bring the app to the front (closes a leftover file picker)
Close a leftover Import file dialog (Cancel; only when one is open)
steps.when_js: (() => { const d = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop(); return !!(d && d.innerText.includes('Import file') && [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].some(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Cancel')); })()

steps.text: Leave the app where the case starts (always)

steps_note: General DSM chosen by the user on 2026-10-22: the synthetic Zurich 1 m UTM file from the 10-09 terrain test. Completed 2026-10-23. Tablet only: W044 cannot choose a file through act.py (no CDP file-chooser method), so the web leg waits for that engine verb. Under run.py the case stops at step 8 (handover: the file pick) and steps 10 and 18 (text:Next is refused by label); the 2026-10-23 results come from manual-assisted runs that followed these steps (O-20261023-001, O-20261023-002). c2 (2026-10-26): the engine copies the fixture itself (engine piece 2); the steps are unchanged, so step 8 is still a hand-pick until engine piece 3. c3 (2026-10-26): step 8 (hand-pick) became steps 8-11, sys-tap in the file browser; the fixture moved to its own folder QA-TERR-004; later steps are 3 higher. c4 (2026-10-26): the pick goes Show roots, the internal storage (@storage), Download, QA-TERR-004; later steps are one higher than in c3. c5 (2026-10-26): steps 14 and 22 (Next) run in the runner under its standing rule (engine piece 5); the dataset is named QA_<run id>. c6 (2026-10-26): step 1 closes a leftover Import file dialog; clean-up steps 25-27 bring the app to the front, close the dialog, go to Sites; other steps are one higher.
